scope: Seven fixed semantic input scenarios compare the current authored Game plus common reader wiring, its necessary UI0.6 copy-on-write migration, and the scalar repository change. This is semantic equivalence evidence, not performance or visual acceptance.

comparison.world_scope: The entire world object, including UI, entities, shaders, every observation and all other present fields. No key or value is omitted from comparison.
comparison.byte_scope: Complete {world,save_payload} JSON with object keys recursively sorted. Arrays, values and property presence remain exact. These observer bytes are not called Core canonical serialization.
comparison.digest_scope: The unmodified observation_digest returned by each production WASM is compared exactly at every initial snapshot and successful tick. It is not replaced by a diagnostic sorted hash.

load_contract.frozen_payload_override: Only script and config.runtime_packages['@unone/ui'] differ by variant. The runner deep-compares all other frozen payload values before execution.
load_contract.executed_config_identity: The exact frozen project payload hashes below pin the executed config/scene/assets. The authored project.unone.json hashes additionally pin each selected source project; tool-only project fields are not substituted into the frozen runtime payload.

variants.name: A-authored-wiring-ui05
variants.change: Current authored Game and common reader wiring, before ownership migration.

variants.name: B-authored-wiring-cow-oldrepo-ui06
variants.change: A plus necessary shallow copy-on-write ownership migration, retaining the old repository.

variants.name: C-authored-wiring-cow-scalar-ui06
variants.change: B plus the scalar world repository representation/query change, using exactly the same SDK10 runtime and frozen payload.

raw.per_case_files: <case>-plan.json contains the exact inputs/save; <case>-checkpoints.json contains every complete-value digest checkpoint. Raw Core digest strings are retained in each row.

limits: No browser, server, GPU, profiler, forced GC or performance measurement ran in this comparison. No Product files were written.
Headless semantic replay does not prove native input picking, browser wheel routing, rendered pixels, FPS stability, natural GC frequency or absence of memory leaks.
Battle reuses the copied benchmark save with its Blackwind position/exploration setup rather than natural travel progression.
A-to-B includes both the matching runtime/package upgrade and the necessary ownership migration; it is not an engine-only performance comparison. B-to-C uses identical SDK10 production WASM.
Common authored UI caches and reader wiring are preserved in all three variants. Equality alone does not prove every common cache invalidation policy correct.

SDK11 fused-copy runtime was not used: its build was blocked by Windows App Control4551 before Cargo build-script execution and emitted no runtime. See ui-fused-copy-source-review.json for the build addendum.
